query:
SELECT source_kind, source_updated_at, normalized_payload
        FROM calendar_event_sources
        WHERE event_id = $1
        ORDER BY
            CASE source_kind WHEN 'google' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            source_sequence DESC,
            source_updated_at DESC,
            last_seen_at DESC,
            id DESC
        LIMIT 1
